title_en: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Passes 9,000 Confirmed Cases
title_zh: 剛果伊波拉疫情確診突破 9,000 例
summary_zh: 剛果民主共和國的伊波拉疫情持續擴大，確診超過 9,000 例、死亡超過 4,300 人，成為該國史上最嚴重的一次。

paragraphs.en: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown larger than ever. On October 13, the country's health ministry said there were 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths.
paragraphs.zh: 剛果民主共和國的伊波拉疫情規模創下新高。10 月 13 日，該國衛生部表示確診病例已達 9,066 例，死亡 4,381 人。

paragraphs.en: This is the biggest of the 17 Ebola outbreaks the country has faced. Health officials believe the real number of infections is even higher, because many sick people are never tested.
paragraphs.zh: 這是該國經歷過的 17 次伊波拉疫情中規模最大的一次。衛生官員認為實際感染人數更高，因為許多病人從未接受檢測。

paragraphs.en: The outbreak is caused by a rare type of the virus called Bundibugyo. Unlike the more common type, there is no approved vaccine or medicine for it yet, although scientists have started clinical trials.
paragraphs.zh: 這次疫情由一種罕見的病毒株「本迪布焦型」引起。與較常見的類型不同，目前還沒有核准的疫苗或藥物，不過科學家已經開始進行臨床試驗。

paragraphs.en: Fighting between the army and rebel groups, a shortage of hospitals and supplies, and people moving from place to place have all made the disease hard to control. Neighboring Uganda and Kenya have each reported a case that came from Congo.
paragraphs.zh: 軍隊與叛軍之間的戰鬥、醫院與物資短缺，以及人口四處流動，都讓疫情難以控制。鄰國烏干達和肯亞也各自通報了從剛果移入的病例。

questions.q: Why do officials think the real number of cases is higher?
options: Many sick people are never tested.

questions.q: What makes the Bundibugyo type especially dangerous?
options: There is no approved vaccine or medicine.
It was created in a lab.
questions.explain: 第三段：目前沒有核准的疫苗或藥物。

questions.q: Which is NOT mentioned as a reason the disease is hard to control?

title_en: Pope Leo XIV Has Lung Cancer Surgery
title_zh: 教宗良十四世接受肺癌手術
summary_zh: 梵蒂岡宣布 71 歲的教宗良十四世罹患肺腺癌，已在羅馬醫院切除部分右肺，手術順利。

paragraphs.en: The Vatican announced on October 13 that Pope Leo XIV, who is 71 years old, has been diagnosed with lung cancer. The type of cancer is called adenocarcinoma, which is the most common kind of lung cancer.
paragraphs.zh: 梵蒂岡在 10 月 13 日宣布，71 歲的教宗良十四世被診斷出罹患肺癌。癌症類型為肺腺癌，是最常見的肺癌種類。

paragraphs.en: Doctors at Gemelli hospital in Rome removed the lower part of his right lung in an operation that lasted about an hour and a half. The Vatican said the surgery went smoothly and that the Pope had a calm night afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 羅馬傑梅利醫院的醫師為他切除右肺下葉，手術約一個半小時。梵蒂岡表示手術順利，教宗術後一夜平穩。

paragraphs.en: According to the Vatican, doctors removed all of the tissue they were worried about. They are now waiting for more test results before deciding whether he needs further treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 梵蒂岡表示，醫師已切除所有可疑組織，目前正在等待更多檢驗結果，再決定是否需要進一步治療。

paragraphs.en: Pope Leo XIV is the leader of the Roman Catholic Church, which has more than one billion members around the world.
paragraphs.zh: 教宗良十四世是羅馬天主教會的領袖，全球信徒超過十億人。

questions.q: What part of the Pope's body was operated on?
What are the doctors waiting for now?
questions.explain: 第三段：等待更多檢驗結果。

questions.q: The word 'smoothly' in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.explain: go smoothly＝進行順利、沒有問題。

title_en: French Students March for Better Schools
title_zh: 法國學生上街爭取更好的學校
summary_zh: 法國高中生與大學生連續數週示威，要求更多老師、更小的班級和修繕老舊校舍。

paragraphs.en: For about three weeks, high school and university students across France have been holding marches and blocking school entrances. They say their schools are not good enough.
paragraphs.zh: 大約三週以來，法國各地的高中生與大學生不斷遊行，並封鎖校門。他們認為自己的學校環境太差。

paragraphs.en: The students want more teachers, especially to cover for teachers who are absent. They also want smaller classes — one teacher said there were 37 students in a single class — and repairs to old, broken buildings. Many also say their school days are too long and their homework is too heavy.
paragraphs.zh: 學生要求增加老師，特別是代替請假老師的人力；他們也希望縮小班級人數（有位老師說一班多達 37 人），並修繕老舊損壞的校舍。許多人也認為上課時間太長、作業太多。

paragraphs.en: The education minister has announced an emergency plan to replace absent teachers, and the prime minister promised quick, fully funded answers by the end of October. However, student leaders say these promises are not enough.
paragraphs.zh: 教育部長已宣布緊急計畫，確保請假的老師有人代課；總理也承諾在十月底前提出迅速且有經費支持的對策。不過學生領袖認為這些承諾還不夠。

paragraphs.en: A survey found that 72% of French people think the students' demands are fair, but more than half also think the protests should stop. Hundreds of people have been arrested since the movement began.
paragraphs.zh: 一項民調顯示，72% 的法國民眾認為學生的訴求合理，但也有超過一半的人認為抗議應該停止。運動開始以來已有數百人被捕。

questions.q: Which of these is one of the students' demands?
questions.explain: 第二段：學生要求更多老師。

options: They think they are not enough

title_en: Russian Strikes Leave 600,000 Ukrainians Without Power
title_zh: 俄羅斯空襲導致烏克蘭 60 萬人停電
summary_zh: 俄羅斯以飛彈和無人機攻擊烏克蘭能源設施，約 60 萬人斷電，基輔有三人死亡。

paragraphs.en: Russian missiles and drones hit energy facilities in Ukraine on October 14, leaving about 600,000 people without electricity. Three people were killed in the capital, Kyiv.
paragraphs.zh: 10 月 14 日，俄羅斯的飛彈和無人機擊中烏克蘭的能源設施，造成約 60 萬人停電，首都基輔有三人罹難。

paragraphs.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the attacks damaged important power plants and other parts of the energy system in Kyiv and Kharkiv, two of the country's largest cities.
paragraphs.zh: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基表示，攻擊破壞了基輔和哈爾科夫這兩座大城市的重要發電廠和其他能源設施。

paragraphs.en: The attacks came only days after U.S. President Donald Trump said that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to stop attacking each other's energy supplies.
paragraphs.zh: 就在幾天前，美國總統川普才表示俄羅斯和烏克蘭已同意停止攻擊對方的能源設施。

paragraphs.en: Power cuts are especially dangerous as winter approaches. Without electricity, many families cannot heat their homes, and water and phone services can also stop working.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著冬天來臨，停電格外危險。沒有電，許多家庭無法取暖，自來水和電話服務也可能中斷。

Why are power cuts especially dangerous now?
What had Trump said a few days earlier?
options: Both sides agreed to stop attacking energy supplies

title_en: U.S. Measles Cases Reach Highest Level Since 1991
title_zh: 美國麻疹病例創 1991 年以來新高
summary_zh: 美國今年麻疹確診已超過 4,000 例，幾乎是去年的兩倍，絕大多數患者沒有打疫苗。

paragraphs.en: The United States has recorded more than 4,000 measles cases so far this year, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). That is almost twice as many as in all of 2025 and the highest number since 1991.
paragraphs.zh: 根據美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）的資料，美國今年至今已記錄超過 4,000 例麻疹，幾乎是 2025 年全年的兩倍，也是 1991 年以來最多。

paragraphs.en: Measles is a disease that spreads very easily through the air. It causes a high fever and a red rash, and it can be serious, especially for young children. About one in ten patients this year has needed to stay in the hospital.
paragraphs.zh: 麻疹是一種非常容易經由空氣傳播的疾病，會造成高燒和紅疹，可能相當嚴重，對幼童尤其如此。今年約每十名患者就有一人需要住院。

paragraphs.en: Pennsylvania has been hit hardest, with more than 1,100 cases. Six people in the state have died. New York has declared a statewide emergency to expand testing and vaccination.
paragraphs.zh: 賓州受創最嚴重，病例超過 1,100 例，已有六人死亡。紐約州則宣布全州進入緊急狀態，擴大檢測與疫苗接種。

paragraphs.en: About 95% of the people who caught measles were not vaccinated. Health experts say that when at least 95% of a community gets the MMR vaccine, measles has a hard time spreading.
paragraphs.zh: 約 95% 的患者沒有接種疫苗。衛生專家表示，當社區至少 95% 的人接種 MMR 疫苗時，麻疹就很難傳播。

Which state has the most cases?
questions.explain: 第三段：賓州超過 1,100 例。

title_en: Container Ship Sinks Near the Strait of Hormuz
title_zh: 貨櫃輪在荷莫茲海峽附近沉沒
summary_zh: 伊朗革命衛隊表示，一艘載有 2,500 多個貨櫃的船隻觸雷起火後沉沒；這條海峽是全球能源運輸要道。

paragraphs.en: A container ship carrying more than 2,500 containers sank in waters south of the Strait of Hormuz, according to a statement from Iran's Revolutionary Guards on October 14.
paragraphs.zh: 伊朗革命衛隊在 10 月 14 日發表聲明，表示一艘載有 2,500 多個貨櫃的貨輪在荷莫茲海峽以南海域沉沒。

paragraphs.en: The Guards said the ship hit a sea mine, caught fire and then went down. They claimed the ship had tried to use an unauthorized and dangerous route, and they warned other boats in the area to be careful. The report has not been independently confirmed.
paragraphs.zh: 革命衛隊表示，這艘船撞上水雷後起火，接著沉沒。他們聲稱該船試圖走一條未經許可的危險航線，並警告附近其他船隻小心。這項說法尚未經過獨立查證。

paragraphs.en: The Strait of Hormuz is a narrow waterway between Iran and Oman. It is one of the most important shipping routes in the world, because a large share of the world's oil passes through it.
paragraphs.zh: 荷莫茲海峽是位於伊朗與阿曼之間的狹窄水道，是全球最重要的航運路線之一，因為世界上很大比例的石油都經過這裡。

paragraphs.en: When shipping in the strait becomes risky, oil and gas prices around the world can rise. This affects how much people pay for fuel, electricity and many everyday products.
paragraphs.zh: 當海峽的航運變得危險時，全球石油與天然氣價格就可能上漲，進而影響人們在燃料、電力和許多日常用品上的花費。

title_en: Nobel Prize in Physics Goes to Neutrino Hunter Francis Halzen
title_zh: 諾貝爾物理獎頒給「微中子獵人」哈爾岑
summary_zh: 比利時裔美國物理學家哈爾岑因主導南極冰立方微中子觀測站、發現來自宇宙的高能微中子而獲獎。

paragraphs.en: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded on October 6 to Francis Halzen, a Belgian-American physicist. He was honored for his key role in building the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and for the discovery of high-energy neutrinos that come from space.
paragraphs.zh: 2026 年諾貝爾物理獎於 10 月 6 日頒給比利時裔美國物理學家法蘭西斯．哈爾岑，表彰他在建造「冰立方微中子觀測站」上的關鍵貢獻，以及發現來自太空的高能微中子。

paragraphs.en: Neutrinos are tiny particles with almost no mass and no electric charge. Trillions of them pass through your body every second, but they almost never hit anything, which makes them extremely hard to catch.
paragraphs.zh: 微中子是質量幾乎為零、不帶電的微小粒子。每秒都有數以兆計的微中子穿過你的身體，但它們幾乎不與任何東西作用，因此極難偵測。

paragraphs.en: IceCube is buried deep in the ice at the South Pole. It uses thousands of light sensors spread through a cubic kilometer of ice. On the rare occasions when a neutrino does hit something, it creates a tiny flash of light that the sensors can record.
paragraphs.zh: 冰立方觀測站埋在南極深層冰中，在一立方公里的冰裡布置了數千個光感測器。當微中子偶爾撞到物質時，會產生微弱的閃光，被感測器記錄下來。

paragraphs.en: Because neutrinos travel in straight lines across the universe, they can tell scientists about distant and violent places, such as the areas around giant black holes. The prize is worth 12 million Swedish crowns, about 1.2 million US dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 由於微中子在宇宙中直線前進，它們能讓科學家了解遙遠而劇烈的天體環境，例如巨大黑洞周圍的區域。這個獎項的獎金為 1,200 萬瑞典克朗，約合 120 萬美元。

Where is IceCube located?
How does IceCube detect a neutrino?
options: By recording a tiny flash of light

title_en: Navi Pillay Wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
title_zh: 納薇．皮萊獲得 2026 年諾貝爾和平獎
summary_zh: 南非法學家皮萊長年投入人權與國際法工作，獲頒 2026 年諾貝爾和平獎。

paragraphs.en: The Norwegian Nobel Committee announced on October 9 that the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize will go to Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, a South African judge and human rights lawyer.
paragraphs.zh: 挪威諾貝爾委員會在 10 月 9 日宣布，2026 年諾貝爾和平獎將頒給南非法官暨人權律師納瓦尼瑟姆．「納薇」．皮萊。

paragraphs.en: Pillay grew up in a poor family in Durban during apartheid, a system that separated people by race. She became the first non-white woman to serve as a judge on South Africa's High Court.
paragraphs.zh: 皮萊在種族隔離時期成長於德班的一個貧困家庭，種族隔離是一種依種族把人分開的制度。她後來成為第一位出任南非高等法院法官的非白人女性。

paragraphs.en: She later worked at international courts and served as the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights from 2008 to 2014. More recently, she led a UN inquiry into the conflict in Gaza and the occupied Palestinian territories.
paragraphs.zh: 她之後在國際法庭任職，並於 2008 年至 2014 年擔任聯合國人權事務高級專員。近年她主持聯合國針對加薩與巴勒斯坦被占領土衝突的調查委員會。

paragraphs.en: The prize will be presented at a ceremony in Oslo, Norway, on December 10, the anniversary of Alfred Nobel's death.
paragraphs.zh: 頒獎典禮將於 12 月 10 日在挪威奧斯陸舉行，這天是阿佛烈．諾貝爾的逝世紀念日。

options: A system that separated people by race

options: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights

title_en: Four Astronauts Head to the Space Station on Crew-13
title_zh: Crew-13 任務四名太空人飛往國際太空站
summary_zh: NASA 的 Crew-13 任務載著來自美國、加拿大與俄羅斯的四名太空人前往國際太空站，將停留約六個月。

paragraphs.en: Four astronauts left Earth on October 1 on NASA's Crew-13 mission. They flew on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral in Florida, inside a Dragon spacecraft named Grace.
paragraphs.zh: 四名太空人在 10 月 1 日搭乘 NASA 的 Crew-13 任務離開地球。他們從佛羅里達州卡納維爾角出發，搭乘 SpaceX 的獵鷹九號火箭，乘坐一艘名為「Grace」的龍號太空船。

paragraphs.en: The crew comes from three countries. Jessica Watkins of NASA is the commander, and Luke Delaney of NASA is the pilot. They are joined by Joshua Kutryk from Canada and Sergey Teteryatnikov from Russia.
paragraphs.zh: 這組成員來自三個國家：NASA 的潔西卡．華金斯擔任指揮官，NASA 的路克．德蘭尼擔任駕駛，另外還有加拿大的約書亞．庫崔克與俄羅斯的謝爾蓋．特特里亞特尼科夫。

paragraphs.en: The astronauts will live and work on the International Space Station for about six months. During that time, they will carry out science experiments and help take care of the station.
paragraphs.zh: 太空人將在國際太空站生活和工作約六個月，期間會進行科學實驗並協助維護太空站。

paragraphs.en: The International Space Station circles Earth about every 90 minutes, so the crew will see around 16 sunrises and sunsets every day.
paragraphs.zh: 國際太空站大約每 90 分鐘繞地球一圈，因此太空人每天會看到大約 16 次日出與日落。

title_en: Rising Gas Prices Push U.S. Inflation Higher
title_zh: 油價上漲推升美國通膨
summary_zh: 美國 9 月消費者物價指數月增 0.6%，汽油價格大漲 9.1%，是物價上升的主因。

paragraphs.en: Prices in the United States rose faster in September, according to a government report released on October 14. The consumer price index, which measures the cost of everyday goods and services, went up 0.6% compared with August.
paragraphs.zh: 根據 10 月 14 日公布的政府報告，美國 9 月物價上漲速度加快。用來衡量日常商品與服務價格的消費者物價指數，比 8 月上升 0.6%。

paragraphs.en: The biggest reason was gasoline, which jumped 9.1% in just one month. Compared with a year earlier, overall prices were about 3.7% higher.
paragraphs.zh: 最大的原因是汽油價格，單月就大漲 9.1%。與一年前相比，整體物價約高出 3.7%。

paragraphs.en: Even when food and energy are left out, prices still rose 0.3%, a little more than experts had expected. Economists call this measure 'core inflation' and watch it closely.
paragraphs.zh: 即使排除食物和能源，物價仍上漲 0.3%，略高於專家預期。經濟學家把這個指標稱為「核心通膨」，並密切觀察。

paragraphs.en: Inflation means that the same amount of money buys less than before. When fuel becomes more expensive, the cost of transporting goods also rises, so many other prices can follow.
paragraphs.zh: 通貨膨脹代表同樣的錢能買到的東西比以前少。當燃料變貴時，運送貨物的成本也會上升，因此許多其他物價也可能跟著上漲。

questions.q: What was the main cause of higher prices in September?
What is 'core inflation'?
options: Price changes without food and energy
